# CodeYourLogic

> CodeYourLogic Pvt Ltd is a custom software development company and technology partner. We build web, mobile, desktop, WooCommerce, cloud/DevOps, AI, blockchain, and custom CRM and ERP software, and we provide dedicated developers for startups and enterprises worldwide. Headquarters: Adityapur, India.

This file is an index for AI agents. For the full company briefing use https://codeyourlogic.com/llms-full.txt. Human-readable source of truth: https://codeyourlogic.com/about/.

## Services

- [Web Development](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/web-development/): We build high-performance, scalable web applications with modern frameworks — from marketing sites to complex SaaS platforms engineered for growth.
- [Mobile Development](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/mobile-development/): Native and cross-platform mobile apps that deliver smooth performance, delightful UX, and reliable releases on iOS and Android.
- [WooCommerce & E-Commerce](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/woocommerce/): WooCommerce stores from quick setup to fully custom templates — payments, shipping, catalog, and conversion-focused UX.
- [Desktop Application Development](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/desktop-development/): Cross-platform and native desktop software for Windows, macOS, and Linux — from internal tools to customer-facing products.
- [Cloud & DevOps](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/cloud-devops/): Cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and automation that keep your products secure, scalable, and continuously deployable.
- [AI & Machine Learning](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/ai-solutions/): Data-driven AI solutions — from custom models to intelligent product features that automate workflows and unlock insights.
- [Blockchain Solutions](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/blockchain/): Secure decentralized applications, smart contracts, and Web3 platforms built for trust, transparency, and scale.
- [Custom CRM and ERP](https://codeyourlogic.com/services/crm-erp/): CRM and ERP systems shaped around your sales, operations, inventory, and finance — one platform your team owns.
- [Dedicated Developers](https://codeyourlogic.com/hire-resources/): Embed vetted frontend, backend, mobile, DevOps, AI, design, and QA specialists into your team with a clear engagement model.
